They allow the player to teleport between the different areas. == Interface == {{/UI}} == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" | Condition !Dialogue |- | colspan="2" class="ct" | First Interaction | {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &bLift Operator&f: &fHey Feller! &e[NPC] &bLift Operator&f: &fI control this lift here behind me. &e[NPC] &bLift Operator&f: &fOnce you've explored an area I can give you a safe ride back there. &e[NPC] &bLift Operator&f: &fBe careful not to fall down the shaft though, it's a long way down! &e[NPC] &bLift Operator&f: &fGood luck on your adventures! }} |- | colspan="2" class="ct" | Before reaching the {{Zone|Lapis Quarry}} | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &bLift Operator&f: Venture down into the Lapis Quarry to unlock my Lift Menu!}} |- | colspan="2" class="ct" |Accessing [[Dwarven Mines]]
{{DG|Without [[Heart of the Mountain|{{DG|Heart of the Mountain}}]]}} | {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &bLift Operator&f: That is too deep, traveler! &e[NPC] &bLift Operator&f: For that you require Heart of the Mountain. &e[NPC] &bLift Operator&f: Talk to Rhys, the Dwarven Emissary. }} |- | class="ct" rowspan="3" |{{zone|The Garden}} | class="ct" | None |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &aLift Operator&f: Operating that lift all day takes a lot outta ya, you know?}} |- | class="ct" | Completing |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &aLift Operator&f: Cheers, that's the stuff!}} |- | class="ct" | Denying |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &aLift Operator&f: Back to the mines I go...}} |} == Trivia == *The player must first enter a zone before they can teleport to it.
